summary: Phase 3 frontend testing of Veracity industry page 'Technical Deep Dive' additions. All 4 industry pages (financial, construction, manufacturing, high-compliance) load correctly with zero console errors. Manufacturing crash bug is confirmed fixed. Deep dive content, item counts, and JSON-LD FAQPage 4th question all verified correct per industry. Regression spot-checks (homepage, Phase 1 service page, Phase 2 resource page) all pass with zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Code reviewed for industryData.js, IndustryDeepDive.jsx, IndustryPage/index.jsx, industryStructuredData.js - all additive and scoped correctly, no regressions found.

Financial Services correctly has 4 deepDive items (index 0-3) while other 3 industries have 3 items (index 0-2) as expected per spec; component and FAQ builder both handle variable array length dynamically via .map(), so no hardcoded index assumptions - good defensive design.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 verified 100% pass. Manufacturing-it-support crash bug (undefined deepDive.map) is confirmed fixed with zero PAGE ERROR / console errors on reload. Verified all 4 industry pages: /industries/financial-it-support (4 deep dive items: SOC 2 Compliance, Vendor & Third-Party Risk Management, AI Governance for Advisory Firms, Business Continuity for Trading Operations), /industries/construction-it-support (3 items: BIM Security, Procore & Sage Integration, Business Continuity for Active Job Sites), /industries/manufacturing-it-support (3 items: ERP System Security, Industrial IoT Device Management, Network Segmentation Architecture), /industries/high-compliance-it-support (3 items: PCI-DSS, CMMC Level 2 Enclave, Multi-Framework Documentation). Content unique per industry, no duplication observed. Each industry page's own FAQPage JSON-LD schema now has exactly 4 questions (4th built from deepDive content), Service/WebPage/BreadcrumbList schemas present and unchanged. Note: homepage has a separate, larger global FAQPage schema (23 questions) unrelated to the per-industry FAQ schema - this is pre-existing and not part of Phase 3 changes, no conflict found. Regression: industry-challenges, industry-testimonials, other-industry links, sticky nav, footer all render correctly on all 4 pages. Spot-checked homepage, /services/managed-it-services (Phase 1), /resources/msp-vs-break-fix-it-support (Phase 2) - all load fine, zero console errors, confirming Phase 3 changes were properly scoped to industry pages only.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no new bugs found in this test cycle. Previously reported manufacturing crash (deepDive field silently not applied during initial edit) was already fixed by main agent prior to this test request, and is now verified resolved via live console error check (empty array) and full page render/screenshot.
